planets.name: TrES-2 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TrES-2 with a 2.47-day year, found in 2006.

text.card: TrES-2 b was found in 2006 by TrES as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TrES-2. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2006, disc_facility TrES, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.47061338, pl_radj 1.36, pl_bmassj 1.49

quotes.title: TrES-2b
quotes.card: TrES-2b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star TrES-2A located 750 light years away from the Solar System.
quotes.introduction: The planet was identified in 2011 as the darkest known exoplanet, reflecting less than 1% of any light that hits it.
